snippet.title: Metanet Hunter G4 v1.1: Obsidian Outback Time Attack 01:52
snippet.description:
I was playing around with Metanet Hunter G4 again. This might be peak Metanet Hunter gameplay until the new project comes out! Please stay tuned for that, it is coming along quite nicely.

You can follow me on Twitter @NightKawata, or stay subscribed to the YouTube Channel for more updates.
